verified_facts.text: The resort is on the coastline of San Jose del Cabo, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located along the picturesque coastline of San José del Cabo, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: The resort is in Puerto Los Cabos, San Jose del Cabo.

verified_facts.text: Jasha Spa has 12 treatment rooms, an outdoor patio and garden, vitality pools and private Jacuzzis.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jasha Spa features 12 treatment rooms, outdoor patio and garden, vitality pools and private Jacuzzis.

verified_facts.text: The spa's main highlight is its traditional temazcal, a Mexican sweat lodge used by ancient Aztecs to promote healing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The main highlight is the spa's traditional temazcal, a Mexican sweat lodge used by ancient Aztecs as a therapeutic instrument to promote healing.

verified_facts.text: Jasha Spa is inspired by natural healing ingredients found in the surrounding botanical garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Jasha Spa is inspired by natural healing ingredients found in the surrounding botanical garden.

verified_facts.text: The spa's pools, locker areas and saunas are separate for men and women.
verified_facts.excerpt: All pools, locker areas and saunas are separate for him and for her.

verified_facts.text: Casa Maat is a boutique retreat within the resort with personalized butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casa Maat at JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa offers a mindful luxury retreat with personalized butler service.

verified_facts.text: A room or suite at Casa Maat includes access to an exclusive pool, Jacuzzi, cabanas and a lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Book a room or suite at Casa Maat for access to an exclusive pool, Jacuzzi, cabanas and a lounge

verified_facts.text: The suites have a residential-like design by Jim Olson.

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by IDEA Asociados and Olson Kunding Architects, with clean lines, stone, concrete and views of the Sea of Cortez.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by by IDEA Asociados and Olson Kunding Architects, it's all clean lines, sharp angles, stone, concrete—and views of the Sea of Cortez.

verified_facts.text: The terraced gardens include a sculpture by Jaume Plensa.

verified_facts.text: The saltwater pool is made up of three tiered pools facing the ocean.

verified_facts.text: Cafe des Artistes, by chef Thierry Blouet, fuses Mexican cuisine with French elegance, with live piano music each evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: designed by chef Thierry Blouet, a master at fusing the best of Mexico with French elegance. A sophisticated space where every dish is a work of culinary art and each evening is accompanied by live piano music.

verified_facts.text: MarHumo celebrates Baja cuisine under chef Javier Plascencia, with a selection of artisanal mezcals.
verified_facts.excerpt: MarHumo celebrates the essence of la Baja under the vision of chef Javier Plascencia, Baja California’s gastronomy ambassador and Michelin-star recipient, complemented by a curated selection of artisanal mezcales.
